facts.fact: 她清楚自己是不受欢迎的人：他在这座岛上 unwelcome，她同样想上岸
facts.anchor: I am an unwanted guest in his home, on his island

facts.fact: 她偷穿了他亡妻的雨靴，他只回了这一句：脱下来
雨靴是他妻子的；他准她穿亡妻的衣服，却不准穿这双靴子
facts.anchor: the boots must have been his wife’s

facts.fact: 他指着海说那不是海，是个能把人吞掉的黑洞，水手死在那里
facts.anchor: It’s a black hole that’ll swallow ye up.

facts.fact: 屋里没有多余的卧室，他睡客厅沙发，她占他的床
facts.anchor: The farmhouse is old, small, no spare bedroom.

facts.fact: 岛上的第七个夜晚，可能等于大陆上的几个月——时间被扭曲了
facts.anchor: Seven days here could mean months on the mainland.

facts.fact: 她开始怀疑：也许自己正躺在法罗群岛的医院里，在昏迷的噩梦里
facts.anchor: Maybe I’m lying in a hospital bed back in the Faroe Islands, trapped in a coma-induced nightmare.

facts.fact: 半夜母羊要生产，他用听不懂的语言低声安抚
facts.anchor: Best to let the rhythm of her body see this through.

facts.fact: 他的妻子和孩子的坟仍在岛的另一端，从屋里能看见
facts.anchor: The grave is still there, at the far edge of the island

facts.fact: 床头书是罗伯特·彭斯的诗与歌全集
facts.anchor: A Scottish poet, if I remember right.

facts.fact: 她把无法再爱归咎于自己"营养不良的心"里的缺陷
facts.anchor: A defect in my worthless, malnourished heart.

facts.fact: 他教她一个苏格兰词：Solasta，指在特定光线下闪烁发光的样子
他终于说出那晚：妻子穿着这双靴子进了产房
facts.anchor: My wife was wearing them the day she went into labor.
